# Push credentials
{: .no_toc }

Configure APNs, FCM and Web Push for an Application so it can send push notifications.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `APL-07` |
| **Route** | `/dev/apps/:appId/push` · deep link `substratal://dev/apps/:appId/push` |
| **Where** | Developer › Applications |
| **Who can use it** | Owner or applications.manage with a User token (write); app key / owner (read) |
| **Kind** | tab |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwViewStack` page |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Providers | list | PushCredential per provider apns \ | fcm \ | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Add APNs | form | POST body: provider apns, team_id (10), key_id (10), topic (bundle id), private_key (.p8) | file picker / drop / paste for the .p8; key never shown again | AdwDialog form |
| Add FCM | form | POST body: provider fcm, service_account (JSON file) | drop/pick the downloaded JSON; validate shape client-side | AdwDialog form |
| Add Web Push | form | POST body: provider web_push, subject (mailto:/https:) | platform generates VAPID keys; show vapid_public_key with Copy for the web client | AdwDialog form |
| Rotate / fix | form | PATCH /applications/{id}/push-credentials/{provider} {key material \ | status: active} | AdwDialog form |
| Remove | destructive-button | DELETE /applications/{id}/push-credentials/{provider} | confirm; web_push removal deactivates every browser subscription | GtkButton .destructive-action |
| Platform alerts | toggle | Application.receives_platform_notifications | mirror of APL-03 toggle | AdwSwitchRow |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Add | `POST /applications/{id}/push-credentials` | 201; 409 push_credential_exists → Edit; 422 invalid_push_credential → field error; 400 user_token_required never happens in the Hub (User token) |
| Fetch one | `GET /applications/{id}/push-credentials/{provider}` | on Edit |
| Save | `PATCH /applications/{id}/push-credentials/{provider}` | 409 invalid_status_transition |
| Remove | `DELETE /applications/{id}/push-credentials/{provider}` | 204 |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- To prove a credential end to end, the owner registers a device of their own app and uses its device test (NTF-03 lists only devices the owner holds).

## For developers

Loads: `GET /applications/{id}/push-credentials`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
